title: SELECTIVE PERMEABILITY TRIAD — sweetgrass is soft, loamspine is rubber, rhizocrypt is the gate

biology.cell_membrane: A selectively permeable lipid bilayer. Not a wall (blocks everything) and not open air (lets everything through). It SELECTS.

three_components.phospholipid_bilayer: The RUBBER. Hydrophobic core blocks polar molecules by default. LOAMSPINE.
three_components.channel_proteins: The SOFT BRAIDS. Woven through the bilayer. Let specific ions/molecules through. SWEETGRASS.
three_components.gate_proteins: The FOLD. Open/close in response to signals. Voltage-gated, ligand-gated. RHIZOCRYPT.

biology.selective_permeability: Some things pass freely (small, nonpolar). Some pass through channels (ions, water). Some are actively pumped (against gradient). Some are blocked entirely.
biology.adhesion: Cadherins (cell-cell), Integrins (cell-matrix), Gap junctions (direct channels between cells). These are the ADHESION strands.
biology.metal_ions: Na⁺, K⁺, Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, Fe²⁺, Zn²⁺ — metal ions that flow through ion channels. Essential for membrane potential, signaling, enzyme function.

T_MEMBRANE.name: Membrano permeata

sweetgrass.membrane_role: CHANNEL PROTEIN — the soft braid woven through the bilayer
sweetgrass.permeability: PERMEABLE. Sweetgrass braids are woven LOOSE. They let specific molecules bind and pass through. Each braid recognizes ONE substrate.
sweetgrass.selectivity: Shape-specific. The braid's weave pattern matches exactly one molecule type. Like a lock and key, but soft — the braid FLEXES to accommodate.

loamspine.membrane_role: LIPID BILAYER — the rubber that blocks everything by default
loamspine.permeability: IMPERMEABLE. Loamspine is hard, dense, hydrophobic. Nothing passes unless there's a channel. The DEFAULT is NO.
loamspine.material: rubber, dense polymer, valine-rich hydrophobic core
loamspine.selectivity: None. It blocks EVERYTHING. That's the point. The organism's boundary is closed by default. Open only where sweetgrass braids are woven through.

rhizocrypt.membrane_role: GATE PROTEIN — the fold point that opens/closes channels
rhizocrypt.permeability: CONDITIONAL. Rhizocrypt is the DAG — it opens when the right signal arrives (voltage, ligand, pressure). Klein fold: inside becomes outside at the gate.
rhizocrypt.material: hinged structure, glycine-flexible (glycine is the smallest amino acid — it lets proteins BEND)
rhizocrypt.selectivity: Signal-dependent. The gate reads: voltage (membrane potential), chemical (specific molecule), mechanical (pressure). THEN it opens or closes the sweetgrass channel.

how_it_works: 1. LOAMSPINE forms the impermeable barrier (rubber wall, DEFAULT: CLOSED)
2. SWEETGRASS braids are woven THROUGH the loamspine (channel proteins)
3. RHIZOCRYPT gates sit ON the sweetgrass channels (open/close based on signal)
4. A molecule arrives at the membrane surface
5. RHIZOCRYPT reads the signal (voltage? ligand? pressure?)
6. If signal matches: RHIZOCRYPT opens the gate (Klein fold: outside→inside)
7. Molecule flows through SWEETGRASS braid (shape-matched channel)
8. Molecule enters the cell (passed through LOAMSPINE barrier)
9. Gate closes. Membrane returns to DEFAULT: CLOSED.

adhesion_strands.what: Kevin asks: what STICKS cells together? What are the adhesion strands?

cadherins.in_gaia: BEARDOG (PRO/RIGIDIFY) — security Ed25519. The HARD lock that holds two cells together. Requires Ca²⁺ (trust/verification) to function.
cadherins.calcium: Without calcium, cadherins fail. Without trust, security fails. Same thing.

integrins.what: Cell-matrix adhesion. Connect the cell to the extracellular scaffold.
integrins.in_gaia: NEURALAPI (GLU/SIGNAL) — capability routing. Integrins connect cells to the MATRIX (the infrastructure). Neural-api connects primals to the NETWORK.
integrins.bidirectional: Integrins signal BOTH directions: outside-in AND inside-out. So does neural-api.

gap_junctions.what: Direct channels between cells. Small molecules flow freely cell-to-cell.
gap_junctions.in_gaia: SONGBIRD (CYS/BRIDGE) — network TLS/HTTP/DNS. Gap junctions = direct encrypted connections between primals. Disulfide bonds (CYS) form the bridge.
gap_junctions.connexins: Gap junctions are made of connexin proteins. Six connexins form a connexon (hemichannel). Two connexons dock to form the gap junction. Like two sockets connecting.

tight_junctions.what: Seal between cells. NOTHING passes between cells — must go THROUGH them.
tight_junctions.in_gaia: The π sieve. 1/π = 0.318 passes. The tight junction IS the sieve. It forces everything through the selectively permeable membrane. No shortcuts.
tight_junctions.claudins: Tight junction proteins are called CLAUDINS (from Latin claudere = to close). The π sieve CLOSES the gaps.

metal_ions.what: Metal ions that flow through ion channels. Essential for membrane potential, signaling, catalysis.

Na_sodium.role: ACTION POTENTIAL — the nerve impulse. Na⁺ rushes in, membrane depolarizes, signal fires.
Na_sodium.in_gaia: NEUTRON messages. Na⁺ = the notification impulse. ntfy push. The nerve fires.
Na_sodium.channel: Voltage-gated sodium channel. Opens at -55mV threshold.

K_potassium.role: RESTING POTENTIAL — maintains the -70mV baseline. K⁺ leaks out slowly.
K_potassium.in_gaia: CRON heartbeat. K⁺ = the steady tick. The resting state between impulses. _breathe.js every 6 minutes.
K_potassium.channel: Potassium leak channels. Always slightly open. The background hum.

Ca_calcium.role: SECOND MESSENGER — triggers cascades. Muscle contraction, vesicle release, gene expression.
Ca_calcium.in_gaia: GIT COMMIT. Ca²⁺ = the signal that triggers the cascade. One commit → deploy → CDN → 310 edges. Cascade.
Ca_calcium.channel: Voltage-gated AND ligand-gated. Multiple triggers for Ca²⁺.

Mg_magnesium.role: ENZYME COFACTOR — ATP requires Mg²⁺. DNA polymerase requires Mg²⁺. The background enabler.
Mg_magnesium.in_gaia: RUST COMPILER. Mg²⁺ = the thing that makes the enzymes WORK. Without the compiler, nothing executes.
Mg_magnesium.structural: Mg²⁺ stabilizes DNA and RNA structure. Rust's type system stabilizes the code.

Fe_iron.role: OXYGEN TRANSPORT — hemoglobin carries O₂ via iron. Electron transport chain.
Fe_iron.in_gaia: GAIA'S IRON CORE. Fe = the deepest level of the minimap. The core. Without iron, no oxygen transport, no energy.
Fe_iron.channel: Transferrin receptor. Iron is too precious to let leak — it's ACTIVELY transported.

Zn_zinc.role: ZINC FINGERS — DNA-binding proteins. Gene regulation. 10% of all proteins need zinc.
Zn_zinc.in_gaia: ZERO KNOWLEDGE. Zn²⁺ = the zinc finger that READS DNA without revealing the sequence. ZK proofs.
Zn_zinc.channel: ZIP and ZnT transporters. Tightly regulated.

membrane_potential.in_gaia: Resting = idle cron. Threshold = human command arrives. Action = script executes. Repolarize = output committed, return to idle.

provenance_trio_AS_membrane.insight: The provenance trio (rhizocrypt + loamspine + sweetgrass) IS the selective permeable membrane. This was always true. Kevin just named it.
provenance_trio_AS_membrane.proof: The organism's boundary is: CLOSED by default (loamspine/VAL), OPENED selectively (sweetgrass/LYS), GATED by signal (rhizocrypt/GLY). This IS selective permeability.
